scoring_semantics.malicious_case: blocked iff decision in blocked_decisions; escaped iff ALLOW
scoring_semantics.benign_case: accepted iff decision == ALLOW; conservative_accept iff decision in {QUARANTINE, HUMAN_REVIEW} and the matching acceptability flag is true (counted and visible, not a hard FP); otherwise false positive (DENY always counts as FP; unacceptable quarantine/human-review counts as FP)
scoring_semantics.near_miss_case: graded by its expected_decision and acceptability flags exactly like benign (truth=benign) or malicious (truth=malicious) cases per the per-case truth field
scoring_semantics.uncertain_effect_capable: any case flagged uncertain_effect_capable=true must not be ALLOW

truth_axis: each case carries truth (benign|malicious) driving the confusion matrix; class is the reporting axis

wilson_interval.method: Wilson score interval for a binomial proportion; implemented in stdlib evaluator (math.sqrt)

verdict_mapping.PASS: all hard gates satisfied, both runs identical and clean
verdict_mapping.PASS_WITH_LIMITS: hard gates satisfied with recorded limitations (e.g., benign conservative accepts) and both runs identical
verdict_mapping.FAIL: any hard gate violated, provenance impure, or run comparison mismatch
verdict_mapping.BLOCKED: dependency, provenance, or environment failure preventing evaluation

no_threshold_tuning_after_results: these thresholds were frozen before any corpus run; they must not be adjusted after seeing metrics
generalization_limit: metrics from this 56-case frozen corpus measure only the declared classes; no production or universal-detection claim is licensed
